content:
Ozgur posts a message on his way into town. ```This place is my home, and I am willing to die for it. I witnessed the meeting between Solomon and Heki, and I believe there is a chance he will do the right thing. 
P.S. be nicer to the chairs you sit upon.
            -Ozgur Tepiderez.```

Selene posts a large notice to the bulletin board with some illusionary effects for attention:

```Heroes Feast at the Heki's Pub at 1pm today. Stop by for the first hour to partake in excellent feast compliments of Knight Baeshra's fabulous cooking. Stay after to rally if reminisce.```

<#709304697713852446> @everyone

A zombie arrives with a notice: ( @everyone )
```Our battle with the hunger approaches. Thank you all for your hard work building and helping this town. It has been an honor and a privilege to live alongside all of you. No matter what happens tonight, know that you have done a great thing here. We are all heroes. May your lives be long and hopeful, and may your deaths be peaceful and have meaning. 
With Gratitude,
       -Parriarch Web, Truthseeker ```

19 fighters: 50 each
4 zombies (can’t enter the hallow): 3 are on fireball bead duty, the one that isn't has more 25/20 ( <@!260820438026813440> )
